words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:ʾinnā}}) gives the ayah its assertive frame before the collar image begins. The particle is not only emphasis: its attached {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) is the governed subject of the opening particle, so divine self-attribution is present before {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) repeats the same speaker inside the verb. That fronting makes the whole chain, placement, collar extension, and final immobilized posture, read as one confirmed divine declaration rather than a loose visual scene. The nasal sound also carries into {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}), audibly binding assertion to action. Across the boundary from 36:7, the register shifts from a proved verdict to the agent who now embodies that verdict as visible restraint.

words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}) is the first finite event of the ayah, and its perfect first-person plural form presents the binding as already accomplished by the divine speaker. Its local frame is not just making in the abstract: {{ar:أَغْلَٰلًا}} ({{tr:ʾaghlālan}}) is the object, and {{ar:فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ}} ({{tr:fī ʾaʿnāqihim}}) supplies the placement site, so the verb installs a restraint system. The root's place, render, and assign senses meet here: the collars are put on necks, appointed as instruments, and the following result clauses show the people rendered into a fixed posture. The broad begin-sense is narrowed to this completed placement pressure, since the perfect form and explicit object-site frame do not leave the collaring as merely underway. The same verb also looks forward to the next ayah's divine placement of barriers (36:9), while the restraint-collar field recalls related placement scenes such as 34:33. Its sound-work is specific too: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:ʾinnā}}), {{ar:جَعَلْنَا}} ({{tr:jaʿalnā}}), and {{ar:أَغْلَٰلًا}} ({{tr:ʾaghlālan}}) carry an open ā/nā/tanwīn chain from assertion to action to object.

words.prose: {{ar:أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʾaʿnāqihim}}) makes the punishment bodily and referentially specific. The word is governed by {{ar:فِىٓ}} ({{tr:fī}}), so the necks are the site of installation, and the attached {{ar:هِمْ}} ({{tr:him}}) carries the affected group from 36:7 into the present image. The plural keeps the restraint distributed across the group, while the possessive suffix prevents it from becoming a generic emblem. The broader {{ar:ع ن ق}} ({{tr:ʿ-n-q}}) field includes foremost parts, leaders, collective necks, and responsibility imagery such as the neck-fastening scene in 17:13; here those are narrowed because the collar context selects literal necks. Still, that narrowed background matters: binding the neck constrains the connector between head, speech, perception, and bodily motion. The phrase also belongs to a recurring collar-neck punishment cluster, with parallels such as 13:5, 34:33, and 40:71. Locally the body sequence is sounded as well as seen: {{ar:أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʾaʿnāqihim}}), {{ar:أَغْلَٰلًا}} ({{tr:ʾaghlālan}}), and {{ar:ٱلْأَذْقَانِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾadhqāni}}) carry a long āq/āl/ān cadence across necks, collars, and chins.

words.prose: {{ar:أَغْلَٰلًۭا}} ({{tr:ʾaghlālan}}) is the thing placed: an accusative direct object after the body-site phrase. Its indefinite broken plural leaves the collars unspecified while multiplying them as implements of restraint, and this contrasts with the later definite endpoint, {{ar:ٱلْأَذْقَانِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾadhqāni}}). The immediate neck context selects the concrete shackle or collar branch of {{ar:غ ل ل}} ({{tr:gh-l-l}}), not a merely abstract constraint. Yet the root family still gives the object inward pressure: collaring, rancor, hidden corruption, and unquenched thirst all converge as narrowed resonance under the visible iron image, with the throat-intake pressure ready to meet the final raised-head refusal posture. The noun also prepares {{ar:هِىَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}), letting the object of the first clause become the subject of the next result clause. Cross-passage evidence sharpens the payoff: 7:157 removes {{ar:أَغْلَٰل}} ({{tr:ʾaghlāl}}), while 36:8 imposes them, and the collar-neck formula recurs in places such as 13:5, 34:33, and 40:71. Its gh-l-l heaviness and doubled liquid pressure make the abstract binding of 36:7 arrive as an audible, thickened collar word before the q-m-ḥ closure.

words.prose: {{ar:هِىَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}) gives the collars grammatical center stage. Across the ayah's pronoun arc, focus moves from divine {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}), to collar-centered {{ar:هِىَ}} ({{tr:hiya}}), to human {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}).

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ʾilā}}) gives the middle clause its endpoint. words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَذْقَانِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾadhqāni}}) names the exact endpoint of the second beat. Governed by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ʾilā}}), it is not an actor or extra body detail but the definite plural limit to which the collars reach. The plural distributes the posture across the group, while the article makes the endpoint specific in contrast with the indefinite {{ar:أَغْلَٰلًا}} ({{tr:ʾaghlālan}}). Lexically, the chin is the lower face and jaw hinge, so the restraint reaches the point of speech and intake as well as the visible lower face. Distributionally the root is rare and appears in directed prepositional contexts; the strongest echo is the inversion of chin-down falling in 17:107 and 17:109, where 36:8 turns the same body part into forced chin-up rigidity. The sound and shape pairing with {{ar:أَعْنَٰق}} ({{tr:ʾaʿnāq}}) keeps necks and chins linked inside one vertical body image.

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) returns the ayah to the affected people. words.prose: {{ar:مُّقْمَحُونَ}} ({{tr:muqmaḥūn}}) is the ayah's closing load. QAC identifies it as a Form IV passive participle and the predicate of {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}), so the people are not raising themselves; they are caused into a raised-head state. The preceding collars reaching {{ar:ٱلْأَذْقَانِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾadhqāni}}) select the forced posture sense over voluntary pride or a simple raised-head image. The root-family image of an animal raising its head from water without drinking gives the posture a blocked-intake pressure: the throat-neck area is constrained just where reception would occur. The wheat or stalk association survives only as a secondary uprightness resonance, not as the local sense. The word is also a Quranic hapax, and uniquely a passive participle, so the whole {{ar:ق م ح}} ({{tr:q-m-ḥ}}) field enters the corpus here as imposed affectedness. Its qāf-ḥāʾ texture and nasal m/n frame make the closing word sound throat-heavy at the point where it names a constrained neck-throat posture. As the final word, it gathers the chain: divine placement, collar extension, and human condition collapse into one immobilized posture, reversing the chin-down movement of 17:107 and 17:109.

topics.headline: the final predicate is an imposed state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on a condition imposed on the people, not on an action they perform.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a passive participle predicate, and attachment evidence makes it the khabar of the human pronoun.

topics.headline: Form IV passive selects forced head-raising
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the posture is caused by restraint; it is not voluntary arrogance or self-raised bearing.
topics.reason: The Form IV passive morphology and collar-to-chin context select the forced raised-head branch over base or active readings.

topics.headline: camel refusal gives blocked reception pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the forced head-up posture evokes an animal at water unable or refusing to drink, making guidance refusal bodily.
topics.reason: The camel/water image is part of the supplied root-family evidence and fits the local neck-throat scene, but it remains imagery under the forced-posture sense.

topics.headline: grain imagery only reinforces uprightness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a secondary uprightness pressure from the grain/stalk field without mistaking it for the local meaning.
topics.reason: V4 lists grain-related senses, but the local passive participle and collar scene select forced raised-head posture; the grain branch survives only as secondary resonance.

topics.headline: the plural predicate covers the whole group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final posture is spread over the same referenced group rather than isolated to one example.
topics.reason: The masculine plural ending agrees with the human pronoun and the referent-chain evidence ties it to the same group.

topics.headline: the unique root appears only as imposed affectedness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare posture-word must carry the whole Quranic presentation of its root in one passive form.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles mark the root as a single occurrence, and QAC marks the local form as passive participle.

topics.headline: the last word resolves the chain by inverted posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word gathering the whole causal chain into a posture that reverses the chin-down movement of 17:107 and 17:109.
topics.reason: The final position, result-clause chain, and concrete 17:107 and 17:109 chin references support the closure and inversion payoff.

topics.headline: the sound texture matches throat constraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices heavy throat sounds at the word that names a constrained neck-throat posture.
topics.reason: The phonetic payoff is local and secondary but tied directly to the surface of the closing posture word.

topics.headline: prior refusal becomes locked posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal/security problem from the prior boundary is embodied as a posture of blocked reception.
topics.reason: The boundary row is semantic rather than same-root evidence, and it is coherent with the final forced-reception posture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جعلنا ... في أعناقهم أغلالا ... إلى الأذقان ... مقمحون
baseline_models.mechanism: A made state becomes a neck-to-jaw restraint whose geometry produces the result named by مقمحون: the head is forced up and away from the water while the gaze and throat are constrained.

activation_trace.role: تصيير الشيء على حال supplies deliberate conversion into a constrained bodily state.
The anatomical neck supplies the central hinge between head and body.
The iron or leather collar that binds an organ supplies the restraining hardware.
The meeting of the jaws supplies the upper endpoint of the restraint.
Raising the head from water and abandoning drink supplies the resulting posture and deprivation.

changed_reading.after: The verse specifies a manufactured sensorimotor posture: neck, jaw, gaze, and access to drink are locked together by the two result clauses.

baseline_models.mechanism: Several focus branches converge on a blocked intake channel: a filter checks pouring, the protruding throat and jaw define the conduit, and مقمحون ranges across leaving drink, moving food from palm to mouth, and a mouthful.

activation_trace.role: A cloth that checks poured water supplies a valve-like image for the restraint.
The protruding end of the throat locates the constricted intake passage.
Leaving water after raising the head supplies failed drinking.
Casting food from the palm into the mouth supplies the hand-to-mouth route now obstructed.
A mouthful supplies the terminal capacity of the blocked route.

changed_reading.after: The collars also function as an intake shutoff at the throat and jaws, making nourishment present but inaccessible.

baseline_models.mechanism: The same root that names the visible collar also carries fixed ingress and concealed rancor. The object can therefore externalize an obstruction already embedded within, while the collective neck branch lets one posture propagate through a connected group.

activation_trace.role: Fixed entry into interstices supplies an obstruction lodged rather than merely hung on the body.
Latent rancor in the chest supplies an inward affective counterpart to the visible fetter.
A connected group or segment lets the plural necks register a socially shared posture.

changed_reading.before: An external captor imposes a device on separate bodies.
changed_reading.after: The device may be the visible form of an embedded, collectively reproduced rancor that has become bodily habit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed word before the focus, the front-and-back barriers and covering after it, and the closing command-speech-being sequence turn جعلنا into the material execution of a verdict. The neck restraint is the body's vertical component inside a temporal and spatial enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Conversion into a state anchors the focus as enacted rather than merely described.
A fixed, obligatory entailment supplies the verdict's binding force.
A thing's saying as its signification lets the word become legible as a bodily state.
Filling a gap and partitioning two sides extends the collar into front-and-back blockage.
A cover laid over a thing supplies the upper layer of the enclosure.
The split root's parallel covering branch reinforces concealment without collapsing its mapped inventory.
Literal eyesight names the faculty disabled by the completed enclosure.
Command as binding demand supplies the initiating force at the surah's close.
Uttered speech supplies the transition from command toward occurrence.
Occurrence in time completes the command-to-state mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:7 immediately precedes the focus, and 36:9 immediately extends its blockage before and behind.
The command-speech-being sequence at 36:82 forms a closing bookend for جعلنا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed word, made restraint, surrounding barriers, failed sight, and command becoming occurrence; I infer a verdict-to-enclosure arrow. A live alternative is that these are parallel descriptions rather than one execution sequence.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports one isolated punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: The collar is the bodily realization of a binding word and the vertical axis of an enclosure that closes time, space, and perception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following requires directional responsiveness, while turning one's side away refuses it. The fixed raised head of مقمحون becomes an enacted orientation toward incoming signs rather than only an inability to move.

activation_trace.role: The raised head and withdrawn gaze supply a bodily orientation of non-reception.
Following in another's track supplies the responsive motion available to the receptive hearer.
Turning the side away supplies the volitional counterpart of the focus posture.

structural_cues: 36:11 identifies a follower as warnable, whereas 36:46 repeats habitual turning from every sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, turning away, and a fixed head posture; I infer that repeated refusal has congealed into anatomy. Alternatively, the bodily restraint may depict consequence without encoding prior volition.

changed_reading.before: The restrained people cannot orient themselves.
changed_reading.after: Their inability is also the stabilized bodily form of an orientation they repeatedly enacted: turning away instead of following.

context_deltas.mechanism: Focus branches place grain, hand-to-mouth transfer, and a mouthful behind a neck-and-throat shutoff. Later grain is eaten, while provision is supposed to move outward through spending and feeding. Refusal to release nourishment to others is mirrored as inability to receive it oneself.

activation_trace.role: The collar supplies both bodily prevention and the branch's extended sense of constriction or miserliness.
The throat endpoint locates the blocked passage of nourishment.
Wheat supplies the same grain later brought from revived earth.
Food moving from palm to mouth supplies the intake route.
A mouthful supplies the route's intended completion.
Seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies the available nourishment.
Taking food supplies successful completion of the route blocked in the focus.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the required outward flow.
An allotted gift supplies what is to circulate rather than be sealed off.
Feeding another supplies the social transfer explicitly refused.

structural_cues: 36:33 moves grain into eating; 36:47 tests whether provision will move from holder to hungry recipient.
The focus itself links collar, throat, jaw, and the قمح mouth-and-grain inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked intake, grain and eating, then refused spending and feeding; I supply the reciprocity arrow from blocked giving to blocked receiving. A live alternative is that alimentation and punishment are separate examples of ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: The collar deprives its wearer of food or drink.
changed_reading.after: It images a failed circulation of provision: hands that will not open nourishment outward belong to a body whose own hand-to-mouth channel is closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The branch inventory of جميع supplies a fetter that gathers hands to the neck. The later sealed mouth and speaking, testifying limbs make that configuration juridical: ordinary speech is disabled while embodied evidence is retained and presented.

activation_trace.role: The neck supplies the gathering point for the later branch-defined fetter.
The literal collar supplies the restraint to which the hands can be gathered.
A fetter gathering the hands to the neck supplies an unexpectedly exact mechanical completion of the focus image.
A secured, preventing seal supplies the shutdown of ordinary testimony.
Opening the mouth for speech identifies the channel that the seal closes.
Intelligible speech transferred to the hands supplies an alternate evidentiary channel.
Declaration based on knowledge supplies the limbs' judicial function.

structural_cues: 36:53 gathers everyone for presentation; 36:65 redistributes speech from the sealed mouth to hands and feet.
The focus already places restraint at the neck and jaw.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact hand-to-neck fetter branch and a later transfer of testimony among body parts; I infer one courtroom apparatus. The alternative is that the جمع branch is a distant lexical echo and the scenes remain mechanically separate.

changed_reading.before: The collar merely immobilizes the neck.
changed_reading.after: It can gather the operative hands to the neck and hold the mouth shut while preserving the body as evidence for presentation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to separate supplies both sorting and, in a remote branch, extending the neck to display it. That convergence makes the raised neck of مقمحون a forced mark of public differentiation rather than private discomfort alone.

activation_trace.role: An elevated or elongated extension supplies the conspicuous neck profile.
The raised head supplies the visible posture.
Sorting a thing until distinct supplies judicial separation.
Extending the neck to make it visible supplies the display mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:59 directly addresses the criminals and commands their separation on that day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation and neck-display branches under one root; I infer that the focus posture visibly marks the separated group. The live alternative is that neck display is an unrelated branch and should remain only a lexical resonance.

changed_reading.before: The raised neck is an incidental consequence of restraint.
changed_reading.after: The raised neck may also function as compulsory display, making the judged group visibly separable.

context_deltas.mechanism: عقل joins the faculty that restrains ignorance to the hobbling of a camel. When that inward restraint is not exercised, the focus's outward fetter can be read as its punitive replacement: the body is bound because discernment failed to bind folly.

activation_trace.role: The organ-binding collar supplies the external restraint.
Reason as what restrains from ignorance supplies the missing inward governor.
Hobbling a camel with an عقال supplies a concrete restraint homologous to the collar.
The repeated appeal to restraining reason keeps the inward faculty active near the later bodily reversal.

structural_cues: The question about using reason occurs at 36:62 and recurs at 36:68 after another forced bodily state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reason-as-restraint, a camel hobble, and the focus fetter; I infer substitution from failed inward restraint to imposed outward restraint. An alternative is simple etymological play without causal substitution.

changed_reading.before: The fetter blocks an already completed act of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The fetter is an externalized anti-reason: imposed binding occupies the place where عقل should have restrained ignorance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus fixes head, gaze, and throat; 36:66 removes visual capacity, and 36:67 removes bodily capacity to proceed or return. The split inventory for استطاعوا adds neck extension to inability, reconnecting the later immobility directly to the focus anatomy.

activation_trace.role: The elevated neck extension supplies the first fixed body axis.
Raised head with lowered sight supplies the initial sensorimotor shutdown.
Loss of light and vision supplies explicit closure of the visual channel.
Eyesight names the unavailable capacity.
Transformation of bodily form supplies the more comprehensive shutdown.
Capacity and ability supply what the transformed bodies lack.
The split mapping's long, extended neck supplies a form-distant but exact anatomical return to the focus.
Passing onward supplies the blocked forward vector.
Returning to a prior state supplies the blocked reverse vector.

structural_cues: 36:66 and 36:67 are consecutive conditional transformations of sight and locomotion.
The focus's two result clauses already derive posture from restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visual erasure, bodily transformation, inability, opposite motion vectors, and a split neck-extension branch; I arrange them as progressive channel shutdown. They may instead be separate counterfactual examples of power.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts one local restriction at the neck.
changed_reading.after: It begins a modular shutdown of agency: orientation, sight, forward motion, and return can each be closed while the body remains present.

context_deltas.mechanism: مقمحون forces the head up and sight down; ننكس supplies inversion generally and lowering or reversing the head and sight specifically. Together they expose a controlled postural axis on which the body can be forced in opposite directions.

activation_trace.role: Conversion into a bodily state supplies agency over posture.
Raising the head away from water supplies one pole of the postural axis.
Turning a thing onto its head supplies general reversal.
Lowering or reversing the head and sight supplies the opposed bodily vector.

structural_cues: Both 36:8 and 36:68 use first-person state-changing verbs followed by a bodily result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an upward forced posture and a later head-and-sight reversal; I infer one bidirectional control axis. The alternative is that aging inversion has no designed relation to the earlier collar.

changed_reading.before: The raised head is a fixed emblem with no internal contrast.
changed_reading.after: It is one pole of a reversible anatomy: the same body can be compelled upward or turned downward, so posture itself becomes an index of lost agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Animals are made tractable for riding and eating and are given drinking places; the drinking root unexpectedly includes putting a rope in the neck and stretching the neck to look. The focus inverts that husbandry: resistant humans are neck-tethered, yet their قمح posture withdraws them from drink rather than enabling benefit.

activation_trace.role: The anatomical neck supplies the tether point.
A camel-like raised head leaving water supplies failed animal drinking behavior.
Making a difficult creature tractable supplies the husbandry relation.
Eating supplies one beneficial circulation made possible by animal tractability.
Taking liquid supplies the benefit denied by the focus posture.
Putting a rope into or around the neck supplies a direct tether image inside the drinking inventory.
Stretching the neck to look supplies the same conspicuous neck vector as مقمحون.

structural_cues: 36:71-73 forms one sequence of ownership, tractability, riding, eating, benefit, and drinking.
The focus's قمح branch explicitly evokes an animal raising its head from water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractable animals, food and drink, a neck-rope branch, and the focus's animal-at-water posture; I infer an inverted husbandry relation. The alternative is that the animal and human scenes only contrast gratitude with disbelief without sharing mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The collar treats people as generic prisoners.
changed_reading.after: It may invert the later livestock economy: creatures made tractable receive benefit and drink, while humans who resist are tethered into a posture that blocks the very drink before them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root holds both fixed ingress and concealed rancor; the later contrast between what is hidden and what is public activates the collar as an outward display of an inwardly lodged condition.

activation_trace.role: Fixed entry into interstices supplies the lodged inner condition.
Concealed rancor in the chest supplies the hidden affective content.
Concealing something inwardly supplies the private side of the contrast.
Making something public supplies the visible side into which the collar translates it.

structural_cues: 36:76 places concealed and declared material in an explicit parallel pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed rancor under the collar root and a later hidden/public pair; I infer externalization from inner disposition to visible restraint. A live alternative is that 36:76 asserts knowledge without explaining the collar's origin.

changed_reading.before: The fetter is wholly external and says nothing about interior state.
changed_reading.after: The visible fetter can expose what was lodged and concealed, turning inward rancor into public bodily form.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the restraint through a later drowning scene rather than through imprisonment. It remains anchored in مقمحون's explicit head-from-water branch and the focus collar, with drowning and rescue supplied by 36:43. Downstream prose should present it only as a hydrostatic counter-image, not claim that the focus literally occurs at sea.

activation_trace.role: The neck collar supplies weight and constrained movement at the imagined waterline.
Raising the head away from water supplies the waterline posture.
Drowning in water turns head elevation into a precarious survival vector.
Extraction from peril supplies the rescue that the restrained posture cannot achieve by itself.

changed_reading.before: The raised head simply refuses a drink.
changed_reading.after: Against the drowning cue, the same raised head becomes a futile attempt to stay above a waterline while the collar prevents self-rescue.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation because a tree root branch names the space between the jaws and the verse produces fire from green wood. It remains anchored in الأذقان as the jaw meeting and in the restraint reaching that point. Downstream prose should qualify it as a lexical-material resonance and must not literalize a burning mouth or equate the jaw with the tree.

activation_trace.role: The meeting of the jaws supplies the restrained threshold.
A mouthful keeps the threshold tied to oral capacity.
The space between the two jaws supplies an exact anatomical bridge from tree to the focus chin.
Kindled fire supplies latent energy emerging from an apparently contrary material.
Ignition supplies the outward release that the jaw-reaching restraint holds in check.

changed_reading.before: The chin is only the measured endpoint of a collar.
changed_reading.after: The chin can also register a closed transformation threshold at the jaws, where latent capacity would otherwise ignite into outward action.

strongest_changes: The collar becomes the bodily execution of a fixed word and the vertical axis of the surrounding barriers.
Grain, mouth, spending, and feeding branches turn blocked intake into a failed circulation of provision.
The hand-to-neck fetter branch at 36:53 and the sealed-mouth testimony at 36:65 make the restraint juridical.
Reason-as-restraint, visual erasure, inability to proceed or return, and reversed head posture recast the focus as controlled shutdown of agency.
The drinking root's neck-rope and neck-extension branches activate an inverted husbandry reading across 36:71-73.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah exposure did more than add themes: several distant branches landed on the exact focus anatomy. جمع supplied a hand-to-neck fetter, ميز supplied neck display, عقل supplied a hobble, استطاعوا split toward neck extension, شرب supplied both a neck rope and stretched neck, and شجر supplied the space between the jaws.
remaining_uncertainties: The juridical, husbandry, and jaw-ignition readings depend on deliberately retaining form-distant branches; their mechanisms are visible but should not be promoted to exclusive interpretations.
The arrows from refused feeding to blocked intake and from failed inward عقل to outward fetter are reader-supplied causal reversals.
The packet supports both an imposed external apparatus and an externalized inner disposition without forcing a choice between them.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Restraint fixes receptivity away from its source.** `غ ل ل` B006 is a collar binding a limb, `ذ ق ن` B006 is support under the chin, and `ق م ح` B001 is raising the head away from water. The upward chain reaches the chin and produces the stated posture; 36:33-35 and 36:73 later make water and nourishment signs of provision. I infer that the posture blocks taking in what sustains. The image reads as engineered non-reception, not generic punishment.
2. **Hidden hostility becomes bodily apparatus.** `غ ل ل` B005 is rancor hidden in the chest, while `ج ع ل` B002 turns something into a state. Later secret and public contents are both known (36:76), and mouths are sealed while limbs disclose acquisition (36:65). I infer that inward rancor is externalized as a constraining posture. The collars can therefore materialize an internal refusal without replacing their literal binding image.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:73's drinks unexpectedly returned to `ق م ح` B001: the raised head is specifically a posture away from provision. 36:65 also confirmed the conversion of inward states into bodily evidence.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A concealed interior disposition becomes bodily posture.** **غ ل ل B005** (“rancor hidden in the chest”) is activated behind the surface shackle sense **غ ل ل B006** in **أَغْلَٰلًا**; **ج ع ل B002** supplies transformation into a state. The preceding nonbelief (36:7) and following loss of sight (36:9) are packet facts. The inferred arrow is *inward refusal/rancor → binding at the neck → head forced away from receptive sight*, with the first causal direction supplied abductively. The image can therefore externalize an internal restraint rather than depict an unrelated punishment only.
2. **Refusal to drink as a model of refused warning.** **ق م ح B001** anchors **مُّقْمَحُونَ** in an animal raising its head away from water; **ذ ق ن B006** adds the support-under-the-chin image to **ٱلْأَذْقَانِ**. Descent and warning in 36:5–6 supply what is offered, while 36:9 supplies consequent non-seeing. The abduction is *warning is functionally drink; the collar props the chin so the offered provision cannot be taken*. The terminal participle now depicts deprivation through forced refusal.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:11's follower moves by an unseen reminder, showing that the fixed shackle is not ordinary lack of visual evidence but a posture that blocks receptive tracking; 36:12's preserved traces reinforce that contrast.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Orientation is disabled by controlling the body's angle or sealing the spatial field through which it could advance and see.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same lexical field that gives wisdom the function of a rein also exposes how guidance can be inverted into a yoke that prevents motion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rein, neck, yoke, and raised chin
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A head-control apparatus closes around the neck, braces the chin, and fixes the head in a non-drinking, non-navigating posture.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: restraining rein around the jaws (quranic:root_000348:B006/m01); neck and collar-bearing member (quranic:root_001053:B001/m01); iron or leather yoke (quranic:root_001102:B006/m01); chin as jaw-junction (quranic:root_000515:B001/m01); support forced under the chin (quranic:root_000515:B006/m01); head raised away from water (quranic:root_001254:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene resolves into a complete control mechanism: a rein governs the jaws, a yoke grips the neck, a brace occupies the chin, and the resulting head-angle prevents ordinary lowering toward water. The surface image of disbelief is thereby materialized as forced posture and failed access.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, çekimli bir eylemden önce gelen yapının o eyleme girişme veya başlamayı bildirdiğini gösterir. Geçici çerçevedeki genel bağlı kalma ve sürdürme yönü kaynak cümlesinde kurucu bir koşul değildir; tanım bu nedenle başlangıç anlamına göre yeniden kurulmuştur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca ardından bir eylem gelen yapıya bağlıdır ve genel yapma, üretme ya da kesintisiz sürdürme anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnızca ardından çekimli bir eylem gelen özel yapıda geçerlidir; yalın kök anlamı olarak genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yalnızca ardından çekimli bir eylem gelen yapıda, öznenin o eylemi yapmaya başlamasını veya ona girişmesini bildirir.

facets.statement: Öznenin belirtilen eyleme başlamasını veya girişmesini anlatan yapı bağımlı bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu yapıyı ardından gelen eyleme başlama veya girişme anlamında ve nesne almayan bir kuruluş olarak ortaklaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: bir eylemi yapmaya başlama
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca öznenin hemen ardından belirtilen eyleme giriştiğini bildiren yapı bağımlı kullanımı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleme girişme aşamasını ve yapıya bağlı kullanım koşulunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ardından gelen eylemin özne tarafından başlatıldığını bildiren geçmiş zamanlı cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Öznenin belirtilen eyleme giriştiği başlangıç aşamasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kaynak tanıklığı çekirdek olarak bir eyleme girişmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başlangıcın yanında eyleme bağlı kalma ve onu sürdürme yönünü de taşıyabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ardından eylem gelen yapılarda başlangıç bildirme bakımından güçlü bir örtüşme vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın güvenli çekirdeği başlangıçtır; komşu dalda ise başlangıçla birlikte sürdürme veya bağlı kalma yönü de açıkça yer alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eylemin başlangıç sınırını ve ona girişmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Olumsuz kuruluşta eylemin ya da haberin kesintisiz sürmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir öznenin bir eylemle zaman içinde ilişkisini kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal başlangıç aşamasını seçer; komşu dal başlangıcı değil, önceden süren durumun devamını ve özel bir olumsuz kuruluşu gerektirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; başlangıçla sürdürmeyi birlikte taşıyan yakın yapı ile yalnız devam bildiren yapı, sınırı en iyi görünür kılar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جعل يفعل كذا، أي أخذ أو طفق أو علق بالفعل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه صنع الشيء ولا تصييره ولا جعله أجرا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: تقول جعل يقول ولا تقول صنع يقول (maqayis)؛ جعل يأكل وجعل يصنع كذا (ayn)؛ جعل فلان يصنع كذا كقولك طفق وعلق يفعل (tahdhib)؛ يجري مجرى صار وطفق فلا يتعدى نحو جعل زيد يقول (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiye yapacağı iş veya yerine getireceği görev karşılığında ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağanı açıkça tanımlar. İnsanların bir sefer veya önemli iş için aralarında kararlaştırdıkları ortak ödemeler de aynı karşılık belirleme çekirdeğine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal iş veya görev karşılığında belirlenen ödemedir; genel armağanı, yapılan işi, durum değiştirmeyi ve tencere bezini kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad alanına dayanır; özel bir söz öbeğiyle sınırlı değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin yapacağı iş veya görev karşılığında ona verilmek üzere belirlenen ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır. Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş için aralarında kararlaştırdığı ödemeler de bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Belirli bir iş veya görevin yapılması karşılığında bir kişiye ayrılan ücret, ödeme ya da armağandır.
Bir topluluğun sefer veya önemli bir iş sırasında kendi arasında kararlaştırdığı ortak ödemeleri de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar iş karşılığında önceden ayrılan ücret veya armağanda birleşir; topluca kararlaştırılan ödemeler bu çekirdeğin özel biçimi olarak aktarılır.

concept_gloss.text: iş karşılığı belirlenen ücret veya ortaklaşa kararlaştırılan ödeme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bir kişiye iş için ayrılan karşılığı hem de bir topluluğun önemli iş için kararlaştırdığı ödeme biçimini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: İşe bağlı karşılık belirleme ile ortak ödeme özel durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir işi üstlenecek kişiye vaat edilen ücret veya ödülün anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir işin yapılmasına bağlanan bireysel ücret veya ödül çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğun kendi arasında kararlaştırdığı ortak ödeme özel durumunu dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sefer veya önemli iş için insanların aralarında ödeme belirlediği topluluk bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun karşılıklı olarak ödeme kararlaştırması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek bir kişiye belirli bir işi yapması için ayrılan bireysel ücret biçimini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir iş karşılığında belirlenen ücret, ödeme veya ödül
önemli bir iş için ortaklaşa kararlaştırılan ödemeler
ona bir ödeme veya armağan ayırmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir iş yapılmadan önce veya onun için konan karşılığı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yapılmış işin karşılığını, kirayı, manevi ödülü ve evlilikte verilen bedeli de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir iş ya da hizmet karşılığında verilen maddi bedel alanında örtüşürler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir işi yaptırmak için konan veya kararlaştırılan karşılıktır; komşu dalın karşılık alanı daha geniştir ve önceden konma koşulu taşımaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir görev için vaat edilen ödülü ve topluca kararlaştırılan ödemeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir çalışanın düzenli iş ücreti veya geçim payı olmasına odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yapılan emek karşılığında bir kişiye verilen maddi ödemede örtüşürler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal görev koşuluna bağlı vaat veya belirlemedir; komşu dal düzenli çalışma karşılığındaki ücret ve geçim payı alanında daha özeldir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel emek karşılığı ile düzenli çalışan ücreti, bu dalın önceden belirlenen görev karşılığı sınırını en iyi açıklar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعل والجعلية والجعالة والجعيلة وما يتجاعله الناس أجرا أو عطية على عمل أو أمر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه فعل جعل بمعنى صنع أو صير، ولا الجعال خرقة القدر.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعل والجعالة والجعلية ما يجعل للإنسان على الأمر يفعله (maqayis)؛ الجعل ما جعلت لإنسان أجرا له على عمل يعمله؛ الجعالات ما يتجاعل الناس بينهم (ayn)؛ الجعل ما جعل للانسان من شئ على الشئ يفعله؛ الجعالة؛ الجعيلة مثله (sihah)؛ الجعل في العطية؛ الجعالة بالفتح من الشيء تجعله للإنسان؛ ما جعلته للإنسان أجرا على عمله (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarını topluluk olarak ve bunlardan birini tekil biçimde tanımlar. Geçici çerçeve hem boy hem küçüklük yönünü ve tekil ayrımını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarına ilişkindir; yer adı, böcek ve genel bitki kısalığı anlamlarına uzanmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad kullanımına dayanır; özel bir söz öbeğinden türetilmiş değildir.

concept_map.definition: Kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarının topluluk adı ve bu topluluktaki tek bir ağacın adıdır.

facets.statement: Kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarını topluluk olarak, tekil biçimiyle de bunlardan birini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçları anlamında ve topluluk ile tek ağaç arasındaki biçim ayrımında birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçları
concept_gloss.applicability: Hurma ağaçlarının boyca kısa ya da küçük oluşuna göre topluca adlandırıldığı kullanımların bütün çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Ağaç türünü, kısalık veya küçüklüğü ve topluluk anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birden çok kısa veya küçük hurma ağacının topluca anıldığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kısa hurma ağaçlarını topluluk olarak adlandırma yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçları; tekili bu ağaçlardan biri

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Küçüklüğün yanında boyca kısalığı da açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnız küçük hurma ağaçlarını bildirir ve ayrı bir söz ailesine dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Küçük hurma ağaçlarını topluca adlandırmada iki dal doğrudan örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem küçük hem kısa ağaçlara uzanır; komşu dalın verilen sınırı yalnız küçüklüktür, bu nedenle tam ikame her bağlamda güvenli değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarının kendisini topluluk olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle yeni dikilmiş küçük sürgünleri ve bunların tekil ile çoğul biçimlerini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hurmanın küçük ve henüz gelişmemiş örnekleriyle ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal boy veya genel küçüklük ölçütüne dayanır; komşu dal ise bitkinin sürgün ve dikim evresini seçer.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı küçük hurma alanındaki yakın ad ile özellikle genç sürgünü anlatan ad, sınırı açıklamak için yeterlidir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجعل للنخل الصغار أو القصار، والواحدة جعلة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه جعلة اسم المكان ولا الجعل الدويبة.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sıcak tencereyi ateşten veya onu taşıyan taşlardan indirirken kullanılan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bezi açıkça tanımlar. Aynı tanıklık, tencereyi bu bezle indirme eylemini de ayrı bir türemiş kullanım olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tencereyi indirmeye yarayan ısı koruyucu bez ve onunla yapılan eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret anlamındaki benzer biçim buna girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad ve ona bağlı eylem biçimlerini kapsar; başka dallardaki benzer sesli adlar tanıma alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sıcak tencereyi ateşten veya dayandığı taşlardan indirirken kullanılan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bezdir; bu bezle tencereyi indirme eylemi de aynı dala bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Sıcak tencereyi ocaktan indirirken tutmaya yarayan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bezdir.
Tencereyi bu bez aracılığıyla ateşten indirme eylemini de bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bezin tencereyi ateşten indirirken ısıdan koruma işlevinde birleşir ve aynı araçla yapılan indirme eylemini de aktarır.

concept_gloss.text: sıcak tencereyi indirme bezi ve onunla indirme
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem ısıdan koruyan araç adı hem de tencereyi bu araçla ocaktan indirme eylemi birlikte gösterileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bezin koruyucu araç işlevini ve ona bağlı indirme eylemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sıcak tencereyi tutup ocaktan indirmeye yarayan bez nesne olarak anıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aracın tencereyi indirme ve eli ısıdan koruma işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Aynı bezle tencereyi indirmeyi bildiren eylem kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tencerenin özel bez kullanılarak ocaktan indirilmesi eylem olarak anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tencereyi koruyucu bez aracılığıyla indirme işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bezin bağımsız araç adı olarak kullanılmasını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sıcak tencereyi ateşten indirmeye yarayan koruyucu bez

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tencereyi ocaktan indirirken kullanılan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bir bezdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tencerenin içini karıştırıp kaynamasını yatıştırmak için kullanılan bir çubuktur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki araç da sıcak tencereyi güvenli biçimde yönetmeye yarayan ev gereçleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak araç tencerenin dışından tutulmasını ve ocaktan indirilmesini sağlar; komşu araç tencerenin içine sokularak kaynamayı yatıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eli koruyarak tencereyi ateşten indirmeye yarayan taşınabilir bir bezdir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tencereyi ateş üzerinde taşımak için iki taşa eklenen üçüncü sabit destektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de ateş üzerindeki tencerenin kurulması ve kaldırılması senaryosunda yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kaldırma sırasında kullanılan koruyucu aracı, komşu dal ise pişirme sırasında tencereyi taşıyan yapısal desteği adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; tencereyi yönetmeye yarayan çubuk ile onu ateşte taşıyan taş, aracın özgül işlevini en açık biçimde ayırır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعالة بمعنى الأجر.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, küçük bir yer hayvanını ve onun kara renkli oluşunu bildirir; ayrıca bu hayvanların çokça bulunduğu suyu niteleyen bağlı kullanımı verir. Geçici çerçeve bu iki kapsamı doğru ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Hayvanın kendisi yalın çekirdektir; suya ilişkin anlam yalnız bu hayvanların suda çok bulunmasını bildiren özel kuruluşta geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın hayvan adı ile yalnız bu hayvanların çokça bulunduğu suyu niteleyen söz öbeği ayrı facetlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kara renkli küçük bir yer hayvanıdır. Buna bağlı söz öbeği, bu hayvanların içine çokça düştüğü veya içinde çoğaldığı suyu niteler.

facets.statement: Kara renkli küçük bir yer hayvanını adlandırır.
Yalnız suyla kurulan kullanımda, bu hayvanların suyun içinde çokça bulunmasını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar küçük yer hayvanı anlamında birleşir; kara renk niteliğini ve hayvanların çok bulunduğu suya özgü kullanımı da topluca destekler.

concept_gloss.text: kara küçük yer hayvanı ve bunlarla dolu su
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalın hayvan adı ile yalnız bu hayvanların çokça bulunduğu suyu anlatan bağlı kullanım birlikte gösterileceğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan çekirdeğini ve suya bağlı çokluk kullanımını ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Canlının kendisi yalın bir ad olarak anıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kara renkli küçük yer hayvanı çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu hayvanların çok bulunduğu suyu anlatan bağlı kullanımı dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Suyun içinde söz konusu hayvanların çokça bulunduğu özel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Suya bağlı hayvan çokluğu ve doluluk yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Hayvanın bağımsız yalın ad olarak kullanılmasını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kara renkli küçük bir yer hayvanı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kara renkli belirli bir küçük yer hayvanını ve ona bağlı su niteliğini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Küçük yer hayvanlarının pek çok türünü topluca kapsayan genel bir sınıf adıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal küçük ve yerde yaşayan hayvanlar alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli bir hayvan adıdır ve suya özgü türemiş kullanımı vardır; komşu dal ise birçok farklı küçük hayvanı içine alan üst sınıftır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الجعل بمعنى الأجر أو النخل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجعل دابة من هوام الأرض (ayn)؛ الجعل دويبة؛ جعل الماء بالكسر أي كثر فيه الجعلان (sihah)؛ الجعل دابة سوداء من دواب الأرض تجمع جعلانا؛ ماء مجعل وجعل إذا تهافتت فيه الجعلان (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dişi köpeğin ve diğer yırtıcı dişilerin çiftleşmek üzere erkeği istemesini açıkça bildirir. Hem dişi köpekle kurulan söz öbeği hem de çekimli biçimler aynı üreme isteği durumuna bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dişi köpek ve benzeri yırtıcı dişilerin çiftleşme isteğiyle sınırlıdır; erkeğin isteğini veya çiftleşmenin gerçekleşmesini bildirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dişi köpekle kurulan söz öbeği ile dişinin isteğini bildiren çekimli biçimler ayrı tutulur; kapsam genel bir yalın kök anlamına çevrilmez.

concept_map.definition: Dişi köpeğin veya benzeri yırtıcı bir dişinin çiftleşmek için erkeği istemesidir; hem belirli bir söz öbeği hem de çekimli biçimler bu durumu anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, baş ile gövde arasındaki uzvu çekirdek anlam olarak verir; uzunluk, boyundaki beyazlık ve boyna bir şey takma kullanımlarını da bu uzva bağlı nitelik ve işlemler olarak açıkça destekler.

concept_map.definition: Baş ile gövdeyi birbirine bağlayan boyundur. Bu çekirdeğe, boynun uzunluğu, köpeğin boynundaki halka biçimli beyazlık ve boyna tasma, kordon ya da benzeri bir şey takılması bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Baş ile gövde arasında bağlantı kuran beden uzvudur.
İnsan veya hayvan boynunun uzunluğu ile özellikle köpek boynundaki halka biçimli beyazlık, bu çekirdeğin nitelik bildiren kullanımlarıdır.
Bir hayvanın boynuna tasma, kordon veya başka bir nesne takmak ve takılan nesnenin kendisi ayrı biçimlerde anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı boynu baş ile gövde arasındaki uzuv olarak belirler; uzun boyun, boyunda halka biçimli beyazlık ve boyna takılan ya da takma eylemini bildiren biçimler bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz öbeklerinde bir yerin, organın, kum oluşumunun ya da meyvenin boyna benzeyen uzun, yüksek, çıkıntılı veya daralan bölümünü anlatır. Her kullanım kendi adlandırdığı yapıyla sınırlıdır.

facets.statement: Boyna benzeyen uzama, yükselme, çıkıntı veya daralma ilişkisi yalnız belirli adlarla kurulur.

Rahmin daralan bölümü ile işkembenin alt veya kubbemsi bölümü beden içi benzetmelerdir.
Olgunlaşan meyvenin sap çevresinde kalan halka da biçim benzerliğiyle bu söz öbeği altında adlandırılır.
